markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section with single-class Invasive call [F1], positive margins [F7], and stain degradation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, others 0% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Maximal invasive risk score |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target (90% coverage) | Single class at guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 30% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input; 70% error AUROC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (82%–94%) [F5]; InSitu contrast 70% | Nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 2, 4) · ↑ invasive · Strongest driver (+2.01); 19/20 AI spot check [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Second driver (+1.12) [F3]; unreliable (0/20 spot check) · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.90); 18/20 AI spot check [F4] · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing 3 top-risk regions beat random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 frozen-section stain degradation causes false invasion or margin calls (70% error AUROC; stains blocked).
- InSitu (BACH_0160, 70% similarity) mimics invasion if duct borders in regions 0, 2, 4 blur.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 4**: Confirm stromal invasion versus InSitu (region 2) and tubule loss (region 4).
2. **Regions 2, 6, 9**: Verify pleomorphism and mitoses manually; mitotic (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) concepts are unreliable.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8, 9, 11**: Check tumor at all four margins (108–323 um involved).

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names Invasive, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
